articleTitle: How to Manage Stress Sweating for a High-Anxiety Event
imageSubtext: It's your nervous system—and it needs a different approach
pinTitle: How to Manage Stress Sweating Before a High-Anxiety Event (Speech, Wedding, Presentation)
pinDescription: Anxiety-driven sweating responds to adrenaline, not heat—so the usual fixes don't work the same way. Learn what actually helps when you're facing a high-stakes moment and traditional solutions won't cut it, from antiperspirant timing to dermatologist-backed options.

items.label: Apply clinical-strength antiperspirant at night to dry skin
Give it 1-2 weeks of consistent use to see results
Schedule a dermatologist visit if you need more help
Consider prescription options or Botox for severe cases
